component.subject: Eucharist
component.title: The Bread
component.source: Psalm 116:10, 15 in the 1979 Book of Common Prayer psalter (its numbering; Hebrew 116:12, 17), verbatim. 1 Corinthians 10:16b-17 adapted from the World English Bible, with "communion" and "one bread" after the King James Version. Every spoken word is scripture.

original.p: Psalm 116:10 (BCP 1979): How shall I repay the LORD for all the good things he has done for me?
Psalm 116:15 (BCP 1979): I will offer you the sacrifice of thanksgiving and call upon the Name of the LORD.

1 Corinthians 10:16-17 (WEB): The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ? Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

p.line: How shall I repay the Lord
for all the good things he has done for me?
I will offer you the sacrifice of thanksgiving
and call upon the Name of the Lord.

block.p: The bread which we break, isn’t it a communion of the body of Christ? Because we, who are many, are one bread, one body; for we all partake of the one bread.
block.rubric: The bread is distributed and eaten
